notes: The Item 7 targeted excerpt was empty, so no MD&A evidence was available. The Familiarity strategic dimension ('serving communities defined by shared values, culture, or experiences') describes the same affinity brands as E2, so it supports E2's significance and is not counted separately. Azar was removed from the Apple App Store on February 22, 2026, after the fiscal year. It remains available on the web and Google Play, so it is still treated as current. Pairs is 'designed to address social barriers' around dating-app stigma in Japan; this is not treated as cross-cultural inclusion because operating in a foreign market does not count. Tinder serving 18–30 year-olds who were 'historically underserved' is about age and is not counted. 'Communities of users' and 'sense of community' describe a dating user base, not the education or collaboration that the Community theme asks for, so they are not scored there. Hinge Video and Voice Prompts are user self-presentation features, not creative work. Headcount fell about 12% in 2025 due to a cost-reduction initiative. No coverage is insufficient, so no second look is triggered.
